bugs.summary: checkPoFile() has a really strong assumption of no blank lines between msgid and msgstr entries
bugs.creator: michaelchirico4

comments.creator: michaelchirico4
comments.text:
This was encountered during patch generation from Weblate -- we're not sure how the errant newline appeared, but the failure mode here is really "scary":

```
library(tools)
lt_po = 'src/library/stats/po/lt.po'
stopifnot(!nrow(checkPoFile(lt_po))) # no issue in trunk file

po_lines = readLines(lt_po)
writeLines(po_lines[1:2])
# msgid ""
# msgstr ""

writeLines(
  c(po_lines[1L], '', po_lines[-1L]), # i.e., insert a blank line after 'msgid'
  tmp<-tempfile()
)

report = tools::checkPoFile(tmp)
nrow(report)
# [1] 152
r5 = report[1:5, ]
class(r5) = class(report)
r5
```

First 5 entries:

```
/tmp/RtmpjsPxdj/file31de61deff9cd:18
Srunmed.c:63
translating strings with "bytes" encoding is not allowed
bandwidth/span of running medians is larger than n
einam\xc5\xb3j\xc5\xb3 median\xc5\xb3 pralaidumas / span yra didesnis nei n

na_action logic error (%d), please report!
na_action logikos klaida (%d), pra\xc5\xa1ome prane\xc5\xa1ti!

/tmp/RtmpjsPxdj/file31de61deff9cd:36
ansari.c:118

probabilities outside [0,1] in qansari()
tikimyb\xc4\x97s [0,1] i\xc5\xa1or\xc4\x97je, esan\xc4\x8dios qansari()

/tmp/RtmpjsPxdj/file31de61deff9cd:40
approx.c:114
translating strings with "bytes" encoding is not allowed
approx(): invalid f value
approx(): netinkama f reik\xc5\xa1m\xc4\x97

/tmp/RtmpjsPxdj/file31de61deff9cd:48
approx.c:124

approx(): bandyta interpoliuoti NA reik\xc5\xa1mes
```

This output makes it look like something's gone catastrophically wrong with the translation, while the fix is really just deleting one character.

comments.creator: michaelchirico4
comments.text:
Created attachment 3399
Allow blank lines between msgid and msgstr entries

Proposed fix to just skip blank lines between `msgid` and `msgstr`.

I don't see anything in the GNU .po file reference about whether this is allowed or not:

https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/manual/html_node/PO-Files.html

Regardless, a little flexibility here to avoid the very confusing failure seen in the issue is worth it IMO.
